entities.summary: Awni Abd al-Hadi, also known as Auni Bey Abdel Hadi and Awni Abdul Hadi, was a Palestinian political figure. He was educated in Beirut, Istanbul, and at the Sorbonne University in Paris. His wife was Tarab Abd al-Hadi, a Palestinian activist and feminist.
